summary: Pablo Hernandez de Cos is set to become European Central Bank president, directing the region’s fight against inflation and possible bond turmoil. title: Global Stocks Climb as AI Trade Rebounds
summary:
Stocks rose as investors in Europe and Asia tracked a comeback in technology shares on Wall Street, with days of sharp swings likely to give way to thin holiday trading. Europe’s Stoxx 600 jumped as much as 1.7%, with gains following late-session dip buying in the US that pulled the Nasdaq 100 back from the brink of a bear market ahead of Thanksgiving.
